summary: Comprehensive testing of Finance and Dokumentenverwaltung permission toggles in AdminPage user management. Backend API: 12/12 tests passed. Frontend UI: All features working correctly including toggle visibility, state persistence, ProtectedRoute access control, and VerwaltungPage permission filtering.

issues: Empty page shown for users without any permissions - could benefit from a message explaining why no options are available

critical_code_review_comments: Finance and Dokumentenverwaltung toggles are correctly implemented in AdminPage under App-Berechtigungen section
ProtectedRoute correctly blocks access to /finance and /verwaltung/dokumente for users without respective permissions
Admin users bypass permission checks as expected
VerwaltungPage correctly filters navigation items based on user.apps permissions
Toggle state is properly persisted via PUT /api/users/{id} endpoint
data-testid attributes are correctly added for both toggles (finance-enabled-toggle, dokumentenverwaltung-enabled-toggle)
test_credentials: Admin: admin@test.com / password, No Perm User: test-noperm@test.com / TestPass123!
seed_data_creation: Set password for test-noperm@test.com user for permission testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Finance and Dokumentenverwaltung permission toggles fully tested. Toggles appear in AdminPage user edit modal under App-Berechtigungen section. ProtectedRoute in App.js uses requiredApp prop to check user.apps[requiredApp].enabled. VerwaltungPage filters items based on user permissions. Anna Weber (ma1@test.com) has both permissions enabled. No Perm user (test-noperm@test.com) has neither permission.
